messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — p99 latency breach on /v1/chat.stream detected (p99 = 1.3s, SLO 0.5s). alert_id=inc-2008061111 link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/slo?panel=streaming_p99

Ben (oncall): taking. paging oncall. anyone know if a rollout happened around 20:10 UTC?

Alice (eng-runtime): yes, we started a canary 8m ago for model rwd-v4-quant (traffic 20%). saw small tail jitter earlier but just now it spiked.

Dinesh (eng-ml): pulling model metrics — checking kv_cache_hit, tokenizer mismatch counters, and queued_request counts.

Carla (sre): proxy logs show streaming chunk TTFB increases and a few connections with many repeated chunk timeouts. no 500s.

Eve (support): customer report: major customer saw chat freeze ~20:18 UTC for ~10s, no error codes, just UI hang.

Ben (oncall): runbook pointer: /inc/latency-runbook — immediate steps: confirm rollout, drop canary traffic, enable fallback route, and consider quick scale. doing the confirm step.

Alice (eng-runtime): confirming: canary initiated at 2008061043, current weight 20%.

Dinesh (eng-ml): quick snapshot:
```
queued_requests_per_worker{pool="canary"} = 14  # baseline 1-3
kv_cache_hit_rate{model="rwd-v4-quant"} = 0.58  # baseline ~0.92
tokenizer_shard_mismatch_count{model="rwd-v4-quant"} = 124
stream_chunk_p95 = 0.82s
```

Dinesh (eng-ml): tokenizer_shard_mismatch is a new metric we added last week for quantized conversions. high count suggests prefix keys are not matching cache keys, causing misses and full recompute.

Carla (sre): infra: canary GPU hosts CPU steal spikes on 2 nodes, GPU util 91% on canary. no pod restarts.

Ben (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) set canary weight->0, 2) route /v1/chat.stream fallback to rwd-v3-stable, 3) monitor queue and p99 for 10m. I'll apply weight change now.

Ben (oncall): executing:
```
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --model rwd-v4-quant --env canary --weight 0
```

incident-bot: Action recorded by Ben at 2008061202: adjusted canary weight to 0.

Alice (eng-runtime): also updating route fallback for streaming to rwd-v3-stable:
```
redwoodctl route set-fallback --path /v1/chat.stream --fallback-model rwd-v3-stable
```

Carla (sre): watching metrics — queued_requests_per_worker dropping towards baseline within 45s.

Dinesh (eng-ml): kv_cache_hit_rate climbing back toward 0.9 as canary drains. tokenizer_shard_mismatch_count stops increasing. stream_chunk_p95 -> 0.38s.

Eve (support): updating customers: mitigation applied, no 5xx, UX impacts reduced. offering postmortem when available.

Ben (oncall): rolling back canary permanently until root cause addressed. issuing disable:
```
redwoodctl model disable --model rwd-v4-quant --reason "tokenizer shard mismatch causing cache misses"
```

incident-bot: Model rwd-v4-quant disabled by Ben at 2008061305.

Alice (eng-runtime): after disable, host kernel spike cleared, GPU util normalized. no more streaming stalls observed.

Carla (sre): final readouts at 2008062000: p99 = 0.44s, p95 = 0.27s, queued_requests_per_worker = 2 (baseline).

Ben (oncall): closing live mitigation. assigning postmortem owners: Dinesh (ML root cause + quant tooling), Alice (serving hardening + automated rollback), Carla (runbook + alert tuning), Eve (customer comms).

Dinesh (eng-ml): will draft RCA: immediate actions: add tokenizer-shard sanity check to quantization pipeline, add kv_cache smoke test for variants, require kv_cache_hit_rate >= 0.8 in canary smoke before traffic ramp.

Alice (eng-runtime): will implement automated rollback trigger: if queued_requests_per_worker > 8 for >=2m during rollout, revert weight. will add a rollout preflight that validates cache compatibility.

Eve (support): "Customer follow-up": scheduling a 1:1 with impacted accounts, sending PM summary and next steps.

Carla (sre): noting oncall lessons: add a stream-specific p95 alert to catch early chunk latency increase (lower threshold than p99).

Ben (oncall): thanks all. re-open thread if regression seen. :thumbsup:
